run.question:
Alertmanager alert PendingPodsDetected (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/otel-demo since 2026-11-16T17:51:57Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The PendingPodsDetected alert is explained by two unschedulable pods created by a rollout of the Helm-managed (release otel-demo) Deployments ad and cart. At 18:06Z exactly two pods in namespace otel-demo were Pending, ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh, matching the alert's count of 2. Both carry PodScheduled=False / reason Unschedulable with the scheduler message '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector', because their pod template sets nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node and no node in the cluster has a hostname label with that value (node hostnames are i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15, i-097278082719f10ba). The Deployments ad and cart are both at generation 2 / revision 2 with that invalid nodeSelector in .spec.template.spec.nodeSelector, whereas the other 19 Deployments in the namespace are revision 1 with no nodeSelector and no other pod template carries it. Events date the rollout: Deployment ad scaled ReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 0->1 at 17:51:00Z and Deployment cart scaled ReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 0->1 at 17:51:08Z, with FailedScheduling warnings repeating through 18:01:23Z — immediately before the alert start 17:51:57Z. The previous ReplicaSets (ad-554b849958, cart-755465879b) have no nodeSelector and their pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p are still Running and Ready with 0 restarts, so the Deployments still report available=1/ready=1 while the new revision has unavailable=1; no request-serving impact of these rollouts was observed. Because two objects equally carry the fault, root_cause names one of the two (Deployment ad); Deployment cart carries the identical invalid nodeSelector. Resource shortage, eviction/OOM and crash hypotheses were rejected on node status and event evidence, and the sporadic ad error spans were not tied to this change because they also occur before 17:51 (and mirror fraud-detection).

claims.text: Exactly two pods in namespace otel-demo were in phase Pending at query time: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; neither had any container status entries, i.e. no container was started.

Both pending pods report PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable and message '0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/5 nodes are available: 5 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.'

Pods ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh (and their owning ReplicaSets ad-dd7f45975 and cart-5b597c6db5) have spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}; the still-running pre-rollout pods ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p and their ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 and cart-755465879b have no nodeSelector and no affinity rules.

None of the cluster's 5 nodes has kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node; the label values present are i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 and i-097278082719f10ba, so the nodeSelector matches no node. All 5 nodes are Ready with no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure condition true and are not cordoned; only i-01a47734339426210 (control-plane) carries a NoSchedule taint.

Deployments ad and cart both carry spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"} at generation 2, deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2, Helm release otel-demo; the other 19 Deployments in otel-demo are at revision 1 with nodeSelector null, so only these two pod templates contain the invalid selector.

The rollout that produced the pending pods happened at the alert's start time: event shows Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-dd7f45975 from 0 to 1' at 17:51:00Z and Deployment cart 'Scaled up replica set cart-5b597c6db5 from 0 to 1' at 17:51:08Z, with FailedScheduling warnings on the two pods first at 17:51:00Z/17:51:08Z and repeated (count 3 each) through 18:01:23Z.

All 6 events in namespace otel-demo inside the authorized window concern these two rollouts only (FailedScheduling on the two new pods, SuccessfulCreate on the two new ReplicaSets, ScalingReplicaSet on the two Deployments); no Evicted, OOMKilling, BackOff, Failed or Unhealthy event appears.

The pre-rollout replicas are healthy: ad-554b849958-42mdm (container ad running since 17:13:37Z, restartCount 0) and cart-755465879b-bgb2p (container cart running since 17:13:45Z, restartCount 0) are both Ready, and Deployments ad and cart each report available=1, ready=1, unavailable=1 while their new ReplicaSets are still progressing.

Trace span metrics show only a very small, sporadic ad error signal over the window (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="ad",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) = 3.046875 span increases for the whole window; cart returned only a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series in that query and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series).

The ad error spans are not tied to the rollout: at 5-minute resolution ad's error-span increase is 1.111 at 17:41:57Z (before the 17:51 rollout), 17:51:57Z and 18:01:57Z, with zeros between; fraud-detection shows exactly the same pattern and frontend-proxy shows errors throughout the window from 17:31:57Z onward, consistent with background error noise rather than impact from the two pending pods.

Cluster capacity or node condition (disk/memory/PID pressure, cordon) as the reason the pods cannot schedule — rejected: the scheduler message names node affinity/selector mismatch and an untolerated control-plane taint, not insufficient resources, and all 5 nodes are Ready, uncordoned, without pressure conditions, with 4 CPU / ~16GiB allocatable each.

Eviction, OOMKill or container crash causing the pending pods — rejected: no Evicted/OOMKilling/BackOff/Failed/Unhealthy events exist in the namespace during the window, the two old pods have restartCount 0 and empty lastState, and the two pending pods never started a container.

The origin of the invalid value is a configuration change to Helm release otel-demo that set nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node on the ad and cart components (both Deployments moved to revision 2/generation 2 with that selector in the same minute, 17:51:00Z and 17:51:08Z, while all other release Deployments stayed at revision 1). This is a hypothesis only: the change source could not be verified because the change_history integration is not available and the release values reside in Secrets that cannot be read.

Remove or correct spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"} on Deployments ad and cart (reconcile the otel-demo Helm values rather than patching the live objects), so the new ReplicaSet pods ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh can schedule; the old replicas continue to serve until then.

gaps: The alerting rule PendingPodsDetected was not found in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned no_data), so the alert expression and its firing evaluation cannot be verified; the alert's count of 2 does match the 2 Pending pods observed in the cluster.

kube-state-metrics pod-phase series are not present: execute_prometheus_instant_query for kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="otel-demo",phase="Pending"} returned no_data and get_metric_names for kube_pod.*/kube_deployment.* returned no_data, as did kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="otel-demo"}; pending state could only be established from the Kubernetes API, not from metrics.

The source of the invalid nodeSelector could not be verified: change_history is not an available integration, Helm release values live in Secrets that cannot be read, and no ConfigMap in otel-demo contains the string 'invalid-node' (that query returned no_data/no match).
The mutating-webhook check failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so injection of the nodeSelector by a mutating/validating webhook could not be verified or excluded.

Application logs of the running ad-554b849958-42mdm and cart-755465879b-bgb2p pods were read (3952 and 12736 lines in the window) but the error-filtered views returned status no_data with no matching lines, which cannot be cited as proof of health; the two pending pods produced no logs because their containers never started.

Events are limited to those whose timestamps fall inside the authorized window, so any earlier state of the ad/cart pod templates (before revision 2) is not directly evidenced; the revision-1 ReplicaSets and pods are the current evidence of the prior configuration.
next_steps: Have a human review the otel-demo Helm release history/values for the ad and cart components to find the commit/value that introduced nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node and correct it at the source.
After correcting the values, confirm both new ReplicaSet pods schedule and the ad/cart Deployments reach a completed rollout (unavailable=0).
Review the cluster's mutating admission webhooks when the Kubernetes API is reachable, to confirm no webhook injects nodeSelector/affinity into these pod templates.
Separately look at the baseline error noise on frontend-proxy and the occasional ad/fraud-detection error spans, which predate and are unrelated to this rollout.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
